digest.component_or_area: tracker footprint measurement CLI and library
propositions: Operators need a reproducible read-only report that separates Git pack bytes, checkout logical bytes, checkout allocated bytes, and whole-clone footprint without hardcoded thresholds or failure criteria based on size

The measurement tool must distinguish between mounted tracker Git object databases (potentially shared via worktree links) and standalone fresh-clone scenarios to avoid misrepresenting object store costs

Packed object byte totals must equal the sum of packfiles in a measured standalone clone; checkout logical bytes and file count must match non-Git working-tree files; allocation reporting uses st_blocks when available and structured unavailable values when unsupported

A fresh-clone mode must resolve the configured remote and branch, create a temporary unfiltered single-branch clone, measure it, and clean up only command-owned temporary state, with nonzero exit only on clone failure not size result

The command must remain explicitly opt-in and read-only, never triggered implicitly from ticket writes, reconciliation, gates, metrics, or Gerrit Verify, and produce no alert or workflow side effect based on measurement values
JSON output must validate against tracker_footprint.schema.json and preserve exact logical and allocated byte layers with ref/tip identification alongside measurements
